title: W090 array-lift tranche: 2 of 34 before the fix, 34 of 34 after, across 14 surfaces
status_plain: The W090 array-support tranche ran 34 cases across 14 surfaces. Before the fix it scored 2 exact typed bit matches and 32 mismatches; only MROUND matched, and the 13 mismatching surfaces are named, BASE and ATAN2 among them. BASE has its own witness row: BASE(15,16,{2,4}) published #VALUE! locally where Excel published {"0F","000F"}; ATAN2 has its own too: ATAN2({0,1},{0,1}) published #VALUE! locally where Excel published {#DIV/0!,0.785398...}. After adding text-returning broadcast support for BASE and routing ATAN2 onto the binary numeric broadcast evaluator, the rerun scored 34/34 with 0 mismatches on Excel 16.0 build 19929, workbook Compatibility Version 2. Both figures are group totals over 14 surfaces; no per-surface split exists. Note the build asymmetry this record must not smooth over: the post-fix rollup names build 19929, the pre-fix rollup names no build at all, and this record does not carry 19929 onto the pre-fix count.
